The '''MJ-52 Miniprobe''' was a type of small [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The MJ-52 Miniprobe appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet that could be acquired from the Constable's Stronghold Pack.
